snippets.description: Wrap in a transaction (rolled back until you switch it)
snippets.body:
BEGIN TRANSACTION

$SELECTED$$CURSOR$

ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
-- COMMIT TRANSACTION

BEGIN TRY
$SELECTED$$CURSOR$
END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
    THROW;
END CATCH
